overview.description: The Vanguard Morningstar Mid-Cap ETF (VO) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Morningstar US Mid Cap TR USD index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of mid-cap stocks in the US. VO was launched on Jan 26, 2004 and is issued by Vanguard.
